pages.title: Bar
pages.description: The bar at the top or bottom of the screen

pages.title: Look
pages.description: Gaps, borders, rounding, blur and animations of windows

pages.title: Theme
pages.description: Colors, glass, fonts, cursor, icons and app colors

pages.title: Desktop
pages.description: Clock and tiles on the desktop

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.description: The dashboard at the bottom edge and the weather

pages.title: Dock
pages.description: The floating dock with your apps

pages.title: System
pages.description: Launcher, app grid, window switcher, notifications, clipboard, on-screen display and power menu

pages.title: Laptop
pages.description: Power profile, graphics mode, charge limit and keyboard light (only what this computer supports)

pages.title: Integrations
pages.description: Personal connections: Nextcloud, Missa, homelab, calendar, sensor and own games. All off until you switch them on

pages.title: Lock & Idle
pages.description: Lock screen, screen off and standby

pages.title: Monitors
pages.description: Resolution, refresh rate, scale, position and rotation of each screen

keys.title: Position
keys.description: Edge of the screen the bar sits on

keys.title: Height
keys.description: Height of the bar in pixels

keys.title: Opacity
keys.description: Opacity of the bar background; -1 = same as all glass (Theme → Glass opacity)

keys.title: Floating bar
keys.description: Rounded glass bar with a small gap to the screen edge; off = full width along the edge

keys.title: Left modules
keys.description: Modules on the left, in this order

keys.title: Center modules
keys.description: Modules in the middle, in this order

keys.title: Right modules
keys.description: Modules on the right, in this order

keys.title: Fixed workspaces
keys.description: Workspaces that are always shown (0 = only used ones)

keys.title: Clock format
keys.description: 24-hour or 12-hour clock in the bar

keys.title: Battery
keys.description: Show the battery (only on devices with a battery)

keys.title: Look preset
keys.description: Last chosen look (choose with the buttons above): glass, minimal or gaming; changes only look and glass values

keys.title: Inner gaps
keys.description: Space between windows

keys.title: Outer gaps
keys.description: Space between windows and the screen edge

keys.title: Border width
keys.description: Width of the window border

keys.title: Window rounding
keys.description: Corner radius of windows

keys.title: Blur
keys.description: Blur behind transparent windows, the bar and the glass panels

keys.title: Blur strength
keys.description: Radius of the blur

keys.title: Blur passes
keys.description: More passes give a softer blur but cost more

keys.title: Shadows
keys.description: Soft shadow under windows

keys.title: Inactive opacity
keys.description: Opacity of windows without focus (games, videos, image editors and fullscreen stay opaque)

keys.title: Active opacity
keys.description: Opacity of the window with focus (games, videos, image editors and fullscreen stay opaque)

keys.title: Always opaque
keys.description: Window classes (regular expressions) that never become transparent: games, video players, image editors

keys.title: Window border color
keys.description: white = fine white glass edge (Theme → Border), accent = color of the wallpaper

keys.title: Title bar
keys.description: Slim glass title bar with window buttons: an = on every normal window, aus = off, nur-schwebend = only floating windows (needs the hyprbars plugin)

keys.title: Button style
keys.description: windows = minimize, maximize, close as quiet symbols; mac = red, yellow and green dots

keys.title: Button side
keys.description: auto = right for windows style, left for mac style

keys.title: No title bar for
keys.description: Window classes (regular expressions) that draw their own title bar (GNOME apps, browsers) or need all the space (games, videos)

keys.title: Window mode
keys.description: schwebend = windows open floating and centered and can be moved freely (like Windows/macOS), kacheln = windows tile automatically; switch with SUPER + SHIFT + T

keys.title: Snap to edges
keys.description: Drag a window (SUPER + left mouse button) to the top edge: maximized; left or right edge: half; into a corner: a quarter

keys.title: Edge distance
keys.description: How close to the edge the mouse has to be

keys.title: Corner size
keys.description: Area at the corners that snaps to a quarter

keys.title: Preview
keys.description: Glass area showing where the window will land

keys.title: Preview animation
keys.description: The preview grows smoothly into place

keys.title: Animations
keys.description: Animate windows, workspaces and layers

keys.title: Animation speed
keys.description: How fast animations play

keys.title: Color mode
keys.description: auto = colors from the wallpaper, grey = grey and white, custom = your accent color

keys.title: Accent color
keys.description: Accent color for the custom color mode

keys.title: Glass opacity
keys.description: Opacity of all glass surfaces: bar, dock, panels, menus, notifications, launcher and settings (darker automatically when text would be hard to read)

keys.title: Glass color
keys.description: Tint of all glass surfaces (neutral gray)

keys.title: Border color
keys.description: Fine edge of glass surfaces and windows

keys.title: Border opacity
keys.description: Edge of the active window and of glass surfaces

keys.title: Inactive border opacity
keys.description: Edge of windows without focus

keys.title: Border width
keys.description: Width of the edge of glass surfaces

keys.title: Glowing border
keys.description: Soft outer glow in the border color around glass panels, cards, the dock and windows (never for games, videos and image editors in Look → Always opaque, nor for fullscreen)

keys.title: Glow size
keys.description: How far the glow reaches beyond the border

keys.title: Glow strength
keys.description: Opacity of the glow next to the border

keys.title: Corner radius
keys.description: Corner radius of glass panels

keys.title: Card radius
keys.description: Corner radius of cards inside panels

keys.title: Card color
keys.description: Tint of the cards inside panels, the dashboard and the settings

keys.title: Card brightness
keys.description: Opacity of the cards on the glass; higher = brighter cards (kept readable automatically)

keys.title: Card brightness on hover
keys.description: Opacity of a card under the mouse

keys.title: Card outline
keys.description: Opacity of the fine outline around cards

keys.title: Active pill brightness
keys.description: Opacity of the white pill of active tabs, buttons and switches

keys.title: Active page in the settings
keys.description: soft = lighter gray pill with bold text, white = white pill like tabs and switches

keys.title: Spacing
keys.description: Factor for all gaps and paddings of panels, cards and lists

keys.title: Panel padding
keys.description: Space between the edge of a glass panel (e.g. the dashboard) and its content

keys.title: Card padding
keys.description: Space between the edge of a card and its content

keys.title: Gap between cards
keys.description: Space between two cards

keys.title: Interface font
keys.description: Font for text in the bar, dashboard, panel and lock screen

keys.title: Mono font
keys.description: Font for symbols and numbers (needs Nerd Font symbols)

keys.title: Desktop clock font
keys.description: Font of the big clock on the desktop

keys.title: Display font
keys.description: Font of the clocks in the dashboard and on the lock screen

keys.title: Font size
keys.description: Factor for all font sizes

keys.title: Title weight
keys.description: Thickness of titles; labels and pill texts are one step lighter

keys.title: Text weight
keys.description: Thickness of normal text

keys.title: Title size
keys.description: Size of titles relative to the normal text

keys.title: Cursor theme
keys.description: Name of the mouse cursor theme

keys.title: Cursor size
keys.description: Size of the mouse cursor

keys.title: Icon theme
keys.description: Icon theme for apps in the panel and the launcher

keys.title: GTK apps
keys.description: Files (Nautilus), dialogs and other GTK 3/4 apps take the wallpaper colors; off restores your own gtk.css. Open windows change after reopening

keys.title: Qt apps
keys.description: Qt apps take the wallpaper colors through qt5ct/qt6ct; off restores your qt5ct/qt6ct settings

keys.title: Firefox
keys.description: Toolbar and tabs in the wallpaper colors (userChrome.css, backed up first); takes effect after restarting Firefox

keys.title: Discord (Vesktop)
keys.description: Vesktop theme in the wallpaper colors (settings backed up first)

keys.title: Spotify (spicetify)
keys.description: Spotify colors through spicetify (config backed up first, off restores it and runs spicetify apply)

keys.title: Keyboard layout
keys.description: Layout code like us, de or ch

keys.title: Layout variant
keys.description: Variant like de or fr for ch (empty = standard)

keys.title: Mouse sensitivity
keys.description: -1 = slow, 0 = normal, 1 = fast

keys.title: Natural scrolling
keys.description: Touchpad content follows your fingers

keys.title: Tap to click
keys.description: Tapping the touchpad clicks

keys.title: Scale
keys.description: Scale for screens without their own entry: auto or a number like 1.25, 1.5, 2

keys.title: Screens
keys.description: Settings for single screens; empty values mean automatic, rotation normal

fields.title: Name
fields.description: Name from hyprctl monitors, e.g. eDP-1

fields.title: Scale
fields.description: auto or a number, empty = like all screens

fields.title: Rotation
fields.description: normal, 90, 180 or 270 degrees; flipped = mirrored, also turned (flipped-90 …)

keys.title: Screen
keys.description: Screen for widgets, dashboard and panel (name from hyprctl monitors, empty = first)

keys.title: Clock
keys.description: Big stacked clock on the desktop

keys.title: Clock format
keys.description: 24-hour or 12-hour clock

keys.title: Clock position X
keys.description: Distance from the left as a share of the screen width

keys.title: Clock position Y
keys.description: Distance from the top as a share of the screen height

keys.title: Clock size
keys.description: Size factor of the clock

keys.title: Tiles
keys.description: Usage tiles on the desktop

keys.title: Tiles shown
keys.description: Tiles and their order

keys.title: Hide empty tiles
keys.description: Leave out the GPU tile while it has no value (–), e.g. without a supported graphics card or while it sleeps

keys.title: Tiles position X
keys.description: Distance from the left as a share of the screen width

keys.title: Tiles position Y
keys.description: Distance from the top as a share of the screen height

keys.title: Tiles size
keys.description: Size factor of the tiles

keys.title: Width
keys.description: Width of the dashboard in pixels

keys.title: Opacity
keys.description: Opacity of the glass; -1 = same as all glass (Theme → Glass opacity)

keys.title: Open at the bottom edge
keys.description: Open when the mouse touches the middle of the bottom edge

keys.title: Close on leave
keys.description: Close when the mouse leaves the dashboard

keys.title: Tabs
keys.description: Tabs in this order (Games only with Steam games or own entries, Lab only with lab.enabled)

keys.title: Start tab
keys.description: Tab shown when the dashboard opens

keys.title: Cards
keys.description: Cards on the Dashboard tab

keys.title: Usage badge
keys.description: Shape behind the CPU and GPU percentage in the Performance tab: wave (like the template) or circle

keys.title: Weather location
keys.description: Place for the weather, e.g. Zürich

keys.title: Units
keys.description: metric = °C, imperial = °F

keys.title: Automatic gaming mode
keys.description: Switch the gaming mode on while a game runs in fullscreen, and off again afterwards

keys.title: Game windows
keys.description: Window classes (regular expressions) that count as games for the automatic gaming mode

keys.title: Own game entries
keys.description: Show your own entries (GOG, Battle.net …) in the Games tab

keys.title: Own games
keys.description: Name, command and picture of own games, e.g. for GOG or Battle.net

keys.title: Hot corner
keys.description: Open the panel when the mouse touches the corner

keys.title: Corner
keys.description: Screen corner of the panel

keys.title: Trigger size
keys.description: Size of the corner area in pixels

keys.title: Close on leave
keys.description: Close when the mouse leaves the panel

keys.title: Close delay
keys.description: Wait time before closing after the mouse left

keys.title: Width
keys.description: Width of the panel

keys.title: Radius
keys.description: Corner radius of the panel

keys.title: Opacity
keys.description: Opacity of the glass; -1 = same as all glass (Theme → Glass opacity)

keys.title: Cards
keys.description: Cards and their order

keys.title: Apps
keys.description: Apps in the grid (name of the .desktop file); missing ones are skipped

keys.title: Quick toggles
keys.description: Quick toggles in the panel, in this order (toggles the computer cannot use are hidden)

keys.title: Dock
keys.description: Floating dock with pinned and running apps at the edge of the screen; off = no dock window at all

keys.title: Preset
keys.description: Last chosen preset (choose one with the buttons above; it changes only dock values, never the items)

keys.title: Position
keys.description: Screen edge of the dock

keys.title: Screens
keys.description: all = every screen, primary = the first screen, or the name of a screen (e.g. eDP-1)

keys.title: Only windows of this screen
keys.description: Each dock shows only the running apps with a window on its own screen

keys.title: Mode
keys.description: floating = windows can go below the dock, reserve = windows keep clear of it

keys.title: Layer
keys.description: top = above windows, bottom = below windows

keys.title: When a panel is open
keys.description: hide = the dock slides away while the dashboard, panel, settings, app grid or launcher covers it and comes back when it closes, behind = it lies below the panel, stay = it stays on top (old behavior)

keys.title: Distance to the edge
keys.description: Gap between the dock and the screen edge

keys.title: Icon size
keys.description: Size of the app icons

keys.title: Smallest icon size
keys.description: Icons shrink down to this size when the dock gets full; after that it scrolls

keys.title: Inner padding
keys.description: Space between the glass edge and the icons

keys.title: Icon spacing
keys.description: Space between two icons

keys.title: Corner radius
keys.description: Rounding of the glass; at most half the dock height (larger values give a pill)

keys.title: Maximum length
keys.description: Longest the dock may get, relative to the screen edge

keys.title: Glass opacity
keys.description: Opacity of the glass; -1 = same as the panels (Theme → Glass opacity)

keys.title: Blur
keys.description: Blur behind the dock glass

keys.title: Border width
keys.description: Width of the glass border

keys.title: Border color
keys.description: auto = like the panels, or a color like #8ab4f8

keys.title: Shadow
keys.description: Shadow below the dock

keys.title: Color
keys.description: glass = like all glass surfaces (Theme → Glass), wallpaper = tinted like the wallpaper colors, dark, light, or custom (your own color)

keys.title: Own color
keys.description: Glass color for the color mode custom

keys.title: App names
keys.description: never, when the mouse is on an icon (hover), or always

keys.title: Running indicator
keys.description: Dot or line below running apps (two for several windows), or none

keys.title: Indicator color
keys.description: auto = accent color of the wallpaper, or a color like #8ab4f8

keys.title: Icon style
keys.description: original colors, mono (grey) or theme (tinted in the wallpaper color)

keys.title: Running apps
keys.description: Also show running apps that are not pinned

keys.title: Trash
keys.description: Show the trash entry from the item list

keys.title: Launcher button
keys.description: Button at the start of the dock that opens the launcher

keys.title: Badges
keys.description: Small number on an icon for notifications of that app (needs the notification service of hypr-shell)

keys.title: Window previews
keys.description: Preview pictures in the window list when the mouse rests on an app with several windows

keys.title: Magnification
keys.description: Icons grow like a wave when the mouse moves over them

keys.title: Magnification strength
keys.description: Size of the icon under the mouse relative to the normal size

keys.title: Magnification range
keys.description: How many neighbouring icons grow with it

keys.title: Animation duration
keys.description: Duration of the dock animations; 0 = no animations (also off in gaming mode or when animations are off)

keys.title: Bounce on launch
keys.description: The icon bounces until the first window of the app appears (at most 5 seconds)

keys.title: Hide
keys.description: never, always (hide when the mouse leaves) or smart (hide only when a window covers the dock); touch the screen edge to show it again

keys.title: Show delay
keys.description: Time the mouse must touch the edge before a hidden dock comes back

keys.title: Hide delay
keys.description: Time before the dock hides after the mouse left it

keys.title: Keyboard mode timeout
keys.description: SUPER + B: back to the app after this many seconds without a key (0 = never); any other key or a click outside also leaves

keys.title: Hide for fullscreen
keys.description: No dock while a fullscreen window or the gaming mode is on; the edge does not show it either

keys.title: Keep clear of the bar
keys.description: When the bar is on the same edge, the dock keeps its distance from it (also with reserve)

keys.title: Items
keys.description: Pinned apps, folders, separators, trash and launcher button in this order

fields.title: Type
fields.description: app, folder, separator, trash or launcher

fields.title: App
fields.description: Desktop file id of the app, e.g. firefox

fields.title: Folder
fields.description: Folder for the type folder, e.g. ~/Downloads

keys.title: Lock after
keys.description: Lock the screen after this many idle minutes (0 = never)

keys.title: Screen off after
keys.description: Turn the screen off after this many idle minutes (0 = never)

keys.title: Standby after
keys.description: Go to standby after this many idle minutes (0 = never)

keys.title: Blur
keys.description: Blur passes of the lock screen background (0 = none)

keys.title: Dim
keys.description: How much darker the background gets

keys.title: Profile picture
keys.description: Show ~/.face (or your initial) above the clock

keys.title: Clock format
keys.description: 24-hour or 12-hour clock

keys.title: Terminal
keys.description: Command for the terminal

keys.title: File manager
keys.description: Command for the file manager

keys.title: Browser
keys.description: Command for the web browser

keys.title: Launcher
keys.description: builtin = the glass launcher of hypr-shell (with calculator), or an own command such as rofi -show drun

keys.title: Notifications
keys.description: Show notifications as glass cards and keep a history (SUPER+N). Off: hypr-shell does not run a notification service

keys.title: Card time
keys.description: Seconds a card stays on screen (urgent ones stay until closed)

keys.title: History size
keys.description: How many notifications the history keeps

keys.title: Volume and brightness display
keys.description: Show a small glass display at the bottom when volume or brightness changes

keys.title: Clipboard history
keys.description: Remember copied text and images (SUPER+SHIFT+V). Off: nothing is recorded

keys.title: Entries
keys.description: How many copies the history keeps

keys.title: Window switcher
keys.description: ALT + Tab shows all windows with previews, last used first; release ALT to switch

keys.title: Windows
keys.description: all = every workspace and screen (and minimized windows), workspace = only the current workspace

keys.title: Previews
keys.description: Live picture of each window; off = icons only (faster on slow graphics)

keys.title: Size
keys.description: Size of the tiles

keys.title: App grid
keys.description: All apps as icons in a glass grid with search, categories, favorites and recent apps (like a start menu); open it by tapping SUPER, with the dock button or the logo in the bar

keys.title: Tap SUPER
keys.description: Pressing and releasing SUPER alone opens the app grid; SUPER with another key works as before

keys.title: Dock button
keys.description: Button at the start of the dock that opens the app grid

keys.title: Categories
keys.description: Category buttons above the grid (Internet, Office, Media, Games, …)

keys.title: Recent apps
keys.description: How many recently used apps are shown above the grid (0 = none)

keys.title: Favorites
keys.description: Apps shown first in the grid (name of the .desktop file); right-click an app in the grid to add or remove it

keys.title: Night light warmth
keys.description: Color temperature of the night light (lower = warmer)

keys.title: Night light schedule
keys.description: Switch the night light on and off at the times below (the panel toggle still works in between)

keys.title: On at
keys.description: Time the night light switches on, like 20:00

keys.title: Off at
keys.description: Time the night light switches off, like 07:00

keys.title: Tips on the home page
keys.description: A new tip on the home page of the settings each time they open (the × on the tip turns them off)

keys.title: Charge limit
keys.description: Stop charging the battery at this level (100 = always full). Kept by asusd across restarts

keys.title: Keyboard light
keys.description: Brightness of the keyboard backlight (unchanged = leave it as it is)

keys.title: Color follows wallpaper
keys.description: Keyboard color follows the accent color of the wallpaper

keys.title: Nextcloud folder
keys.description: Mount your Nextcloud as a normal folder (WebDAV, rclone) with a bookmark in the file manager

keys.title: Address
keys.description: Address of the Nextcloud, like https://cloud.example.org

keys.title: User name
keys.description: Nextcloud user name (the app password is stored separately in secrets.env)

keys.title: Folder
keys.description: Where the Nextcloud appears

keys.title: Cache
keys.description: Space for the local copy of opened files

keys.title: Read only
keys.description: Only read files from the Nextcloud, never change them

keys.title: Missa
keys.description: Your assistant Missa: chat (SUPER+I), dashboard card and the folder ~/Missa

keys.title: Missa-Core address
keys.description: Base address of Missa-Core, like https://missa.example.org (the key is stored in secrets.env)

keys.title: Missa folder
keys.description: Local folder with Eingang (files for Missa) and Ausgabe (files from Missa)

keys.title: Missa may use this computer
keys.description: Missa can find and open files, control apps and windows and, after confirmation, run commands

keys.title: Access level
keys.description: off: nothing · read: only reading · ask: writing is free, destructive actions need your click · full: no local question

warn.full: Risk: Missa can then run any command, change files and switch the computer off without asking you here first.

keys.title: Blocked folders
keys.description: Missa never reads, searches or changes these (in every access level)

keys.title: Device name
keys.description: Name of this computer in Missa-Core (the token belongs to it); empty = host name

keys.title: Talk to Missa
keys.description: Speak with Missa (SUPER+SHIFT+I) and hear her answers, locally with whisper.cpp and piper

keys.title: Spoken language
keys.description: Language for recognition (whisper.cpp), e.g. de, en or auto

keys.title: Speech model
keys.description: whisper.cpp model file (bigger = better, slower: tiny, base, small …)

keys.title: Voice
keys.description: piper voice file (.onnx, with its .onnx.json next to it)

keys.title: Speaking speed
keys.description: How fast Missa reads her answers

keys.title: Homelab
keys.description: Dashboard tab Lab with VMs, servers, containers and alarms (read through Missa-Core)

keys.title: Calendar
keys.description: Appointments from a CalDAV calendar (e.g. Nextcloud) in the dashboard calendar

keys.title: CalDAV address
keys.description: Address of the calendar, like https://cloud.example.org/remote.php/dav/calendars/user/personal/

keys.title: User name
keys.description: CalDAV user name (the password is stored in secrets.env)

keys.title: Sensor
keys.description: Dashboard tile with a value from a JSON address, e.g. air quality

keys.title: JSON address
keys.description: Address that returns JSON

keys.title: Field
keys.description: Which value of the JSON to show, as a path like luft.co2

keys.title: Title
keys.description: Title of the tile

keys.title: Unit
keys.description: Unit shown after the value

keys.title: Warning from
keys.description: From this value on, the tile shows the warning color

keys.title: Own CA file
keys.description: Certificate of your own certificate authority for self-signed servers (checking is never switched off)

keys.title: Terminal
keys.description: Open the terminal (apps.terminal)

keys.title: File manager
keys.description: Open the file manager (apps.files)

keys.title: Browser
keys.description: Open the browser (apps.browser); empty = no key

keys.title: Launcher
keys.description: Open the app launcher (apps.launcher)

keys.title: Launcher (second key)
keys.description: Another key for the app launcher

keys.title: Launcher (third key)
keys.description: Third shortcut for the launcher

keys.title: App search
keys.description: Open the app launcher to search apps

keys.title: Close window
keys.description: Close the focused window (like clicking its X)

keys.title: Close window (second key)
keys.description: Second key to close the focused window

keys.title: Float window
keys.description: Switch the focused window between floating and tiled

keys.title: Fullscreen
keys.description: Fullscreen on/off for the focused window

keys.title: Minimize
keys.description: Hide the window (it stays in the dock and in ALT + Tab)

keys.title: Restore last minimized
keys.description: Bring back the window minimized last

keys.title: Switch windows
keys.description: Hold the modifier and press Tab: next window, release to switch; Esc cancels, Q or Delete closes the chosen window

keys.title: Switch windows backwards
keys.description: Like Switch windows, in the other direction

keys.title: Snap left
keys.description: Window to the left half; from a half, up/down makes a quarter

keys.title: Snap right
keys.description: Window to the right half

keys.title: Maximize / top quarter
keys.description: Maximize between bar and dock; from a half: the upper quarter

keys.title: Restore / minimize
keys.description: Back to the old size; when not snapped: minimize; from a half: the lower quarter

keys.title: Floating / tiling mode
keys.description: Switch the window mode for all windows (fenster.modus)

keys.title: Focus left
keys.description: Move the focus to the window on the left

keys.title: Focus right
keys.description: Move the focus to the window on the right

keys.title: Focus up
keys.description: Move the focus to the window above

keys.title: Focus down
keys.description: Move the focus to the window below

keys.title: Switch workspace
keys.description: Modifier for 1 … 0 (go to workspace) and the mouse wheel; empty = off

keys.title: Move window to workspace
keys.description: Modifier for 1 … 0 (move the window there); empty = off

keys.title: Move and resize with the mouse
keys.description: Modifier for dragging (left button) and resizing (right button) windows; empty = off

keys.title: Dashboard
keys.description: Open or close the dashboard

keys.title: Dashboard (second key)
keys.description: Second shortcut that opens or closes the dashboard

keys.title: Wallpapers
keys.description: Open the dashboard on the Wallpaper tab

keys.title: Panel
keys.description: Open or close the hot corner panel

keys.title: Notifications
keys.description: Open or close the notification history

keys.title: Edit desktop widgets
keys.description: Move and resize the clock and tiles with the mouse

keys.title: Settings
keys.description: Open or close this settings app (cannot be empty)

keys.title: Power menu
keys.description: Lock, sleep, log out, restart or shut down

keys.title: Clipboard history
keys.description: Show the last copies to paste them again

keys.title: Window overview
keys.description: Show all workspaces with their windows

keys.title: Shortcut cheatsheet
keys.description: Show all keyboard shortcuts

keys.title: Focus the dock
keys.description: Use the dock with the keyboard: arrows choose, Enter starts, Menu or SHIFT+F10 opens the menu, Esc leaves

keys.title: Missa chat
keys.description: Chat with Missa (only when Missa is switched on)

keys.title: Talk to Missa
keys.description: Speak with Missa; press again to stop (only when Missa and talking are switched on)

keys.title: Give back the keyboard
keys.description: Emergency: closes all shell panels, leaves the dock keyboard mode and any submap, focuses the window under the mouse

keys.title: Lock
keys.description: Lock the screen

keys.title: Log out
keys.description: Leave Hyprland

keys.title: Screenshot of a region
keys.description: Select a region; saved and copied

keys.title: Screenshot of the screen
keys.description: Whole screen; saved and copied
